    if not resp:
        break
    all_notes.extend(resp)
    # stop if last page likely
    if len(resp) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Update the specific checklist item to mark it as not done
note_id = 3041
current = resp_note['content']
old_line = '[x] Taking a solo backpacking trip'
new_line = '[ ] Taking a solo backpacking trip'
print('old_line present:', old_line in current)
print('new_line present (before):', new_line in current)

new_content = current.replace(old_line, new_line)
print('replacement occurred:', new_content != current)
print('new_line present (after):', new_line in new_content)

upd_resp = apis.simple_note.update_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id, content=new_content)
print('update response:', upd_resp)

# Verify once
verify = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_id)
print('verify contains new_line:', new_line in verify['content'])
print('verify contains old_line:', old_line in verify['content'])

# print the relevant section
lines = verify['content'].splitlines()
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if 'Taking a solo backpacking trip' in l:
        print('relevant line:', l)
